newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Cemig hopes to issue Level Two ADR in '97.
newsitem.headline: Cemig hopes to issue Level Two ADR in '97.

text.p: Minas Gerais state power firm Cemig CMI.SA hopes to launch a Level Two ADR program this year, said Luiz Fernando Rolla, assistant to the company's chief financial officer.
"We expect to convert our Level One ADR program into Level Two ADRs this year," said Rolla before addressing a conference on Latin American utilities sponsored by Caspian Securities.
Rolla said the company has been doing the groundwork to adapt its accounting methods to U.S. standards to allow for the listing of its stock on a U.S. exchange.
